title: Naturality of the explicit derived resolution comparison
statement: Under the assumptions and with the explicit maps $c_I$ of [lem-sc-p1-injective-resolution-derived-comparison], let $f:X\to Y$, $I,J$ be injective resolutions, and $\varphi:I\to J$ satisfy $\iota_I\varphi=f[0]\iota_J$. Then $Rv(f[0]);c_J=c_I;Q(Ev\varphi)$.

source.place: Tags 014Q, 05TE and 015B: item proof Steps 1-4, fixed resolution triangle comparison before homology naturality

proof.text: Choose the actual Mathlib desc lift psi between the chosen resolutions and use rightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIsoQ_hom_naturality.
The composite psi;desc(id_Y) and desc(id_X);phi lift the same f, so descHomotopy gives a homotopy. Apply v.mapHomotopy and extend it by zero, then Q_map_eq_of_homotopy.

Move psi through the quotient factorization and mapExtendIso by their naturality equations, and substitute the equality just proved. The resulting equation is precisely naturality of the explicit comparison. All steps compile without sorry.

theorem injectiveResolutionDerivedComparison_naturality
    (v : A ⥤ B) [v.Additive] {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : InjectiveResolution X) (J : InjectiveResolution Y)
    (φ : I.cocomplex ⟶ J.cocomplex)
    (hφ : I.ι ≫ φ = (CochainComplex.single₀ A).map f ≫ J.ι) :
    (v.rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι).map
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor A 0).map f) ≫
      injectiveResolutionDerivedComparison v J =
    injectiveResolutionDerivedComparison v I ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap
        ((v.mapHomologicalComplex _).map φ) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
